title: Transwestern
name: Transwestern
description:
Transwestern is a comprehensive commercial real estate platform designed to help clients, investors, and partners explore and manage commercial real estate opportunities. The website presents the company’s vertically integrated expertise across Investments, Development, and Services, while providing access to properties, people, market reports, news, and industry insights.

The platform allows users to explore commercial properties, discover real estate professionals, access market research and reports, and stay updated with the latest industry publications. It also highlights Transwestern’s services and development and investment capabilities through a structured, professional, and user-focused digital experience.
challenges: Delivering a fast, seamless experience across complex real estate datasets, property search filters, and market reports while maintaining top-notch SEO and responsiveness.
futurePlan: Integrating AI-powered property recommendations, interactive 3D map views, and automated client inquiry workflows.

title: Shred Nations
name: Shred Nations
description:
Shred Nations is a secure document management and destruction platform that connects individuals and businesses with reliable shredding and information-destruction services across the United States. The platform provides a wide range of solutions including mobile and offsite document shredding, paper shredding, document scanning, document storage, hard drive destruction, electronics recycling, and product destruction.

The website is designed around a service-driven user experience, allowing visitors to quickly explore available services, find locations, identify the right solution through an interactive Shredding Helper, and request a free quote through a streamlined lead-generation workflow. The platform combines content, location-based discovery, service information, and conversion-focused forms to support both customers and business partners.
challenges: Optimizing multi-step quote lead forms and location search to achieve high conversion rates across millions of monthly visits.
futurePlan: Introducing instant SMS quote notifications and real-time appointment booking integrations.

title: Doing-Stand
name: Doing-Stand
description:
Doing-Stand is a content-driven marketing platform focused on providing practical insights, guides, and resources related to marketing agencies and the digital marketing industry. The platform features a structured blog architecture with categorized articles, author profiles, contact functionality, and content-focused navigation designed for an information-rich user experience.

The platform was optimized to handle 100K+ users, with a strong focus on performance, scalability, SEO, and efficient content delivery. I worked on optimizing page loading, frontend rendering, asset delivery, and overall application performance to provide a fast and reliable experience even under high traffic.

features.title: High-Traffic Performance & Blog Platform
points: SSR/SSG Hybrid Rendering with CDN Caching

challenges: Maintaining instant page loads and zero layout shifts under heavy spike traffic exceeding 100K+ active readers.
futurePlan: Building an AI-assisted article recommendation engine and newsletter automation platform.

title: RENG
name: RENG
description:
RENG is a premium e-commerce platform for handcrafted and luxury lighting products, offering a curated collection of ceiling, wall, table, and floor lighting. The platform combines modern editorial design with an immersive shopping experience to showcase artisan craftsmanship, sustainable materials, and high-quality lighting collections.

The website features structured product discovery, category-based navigation, best-seller and new-introduction sections, detailed product presentation, shopping cart functionality, customer account management, showroom information, and trade program access. The interface was designed with a strong focus on visual storytelling, responsive interactions, performance, and a seamless luxury shopping experience.
challenges: Delivering pixel-perfect luxury aesthetics while maintaining fast initial page loads despite image-heavy product galleries.
futurePlan: Adding 3D product view capabilities and AR room visualization for luxury lighting fixtures.

title: Recreation Dallas
name: Recreation Dallas
description:
Recreation Dallas is a creative agency portfolio platform built to showcase innovative campaigns, branding projects, digital experiences, and creative work for leading brands. The website uses a bold, visually-driven presentation to communicate the agency’s personality while allowing visitors to explore a diverse portfolio of client projects and creative case studies.

The platform features an immersive project showcase with rich visual content, animated media, categorized work, detailed case-study pages, agency information, team profiles, careers, contact functionality, and newsletter subscription. The experience was designed around storytelling, visual hierarchy, smooth navigation, and performance to create an engaging digital presence for a modern creative agency.

features.title: Creative Agency & Digital Experience
points: Team & Agency Pages with Careers Module

challenges: Synchronizing complex micro-animations and video assets without compromising mobile frame rates.

title: ScoreLivePro – Live Football Scores & Real-Time Updates
name: ScoreLivePro – Live Football Scores & Real-Time Updates
description:
ScoreLivePro is a fast and modern football mobile application built for fans who want instant access to live scores, match updates, and real-time football information. The app focuses on delivering a smooth, responsive, and personalized experience so users never miss important moments from the game.

The application is designed around real-time data delivery, providing live match scores, timely updates, smart notifications, and an intuitive interface optimized for mobile users. Performance and efficient data handling were prioritized to ensure fast updates and a reliable experience even while handling frequent live-match data changes.

features.title: Mobile App & Real-Time Scores
points: Live Football Scores & Real-Time Match Updates
Push Notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging
Fast Data Refresh & Efficient API Integration
Android App published on Google Play Store

challenges: Managing rapid websocket data updates during high-concurrency match events without draining battery or causing UI lags.
futurePlan: Adding live audio commentary and head-to-head match prediction polls.

title: FastChat – Real-Time Messaging Application
name: FastChat – Real-Time Messaging Application
description:
FastChat is a modern mobile messaging application built to provide users with a fast, simple, and responsive communication experience. The application focuses on real-time conversations, smooth message delivery, and an intuitive mobile-first interface.

The app was developed with a focus on performance, reliable real-time communication, efficient API integration, and a seamless user experience across Android devices.

features.title: Messaging & Conversation Management
points: Responsive Mobile UI & Efficient State Management
Android App published on Google Play Store

challenges: Ensuring low-latency message delivery and background notification syncing across diverse Android OS versions.
futurePlan: Adding end-to-end encryption and voice/video calling support.
